transcript:
SA: Kvarn Kaffe, hej.
C: Hallo, Jonas here from Kaffeehaus Mitte in Berlin.
SA: Hi Jonas! How's Berlin?
C: Grey, cold. Perfect coffee weather.
SA: Ha. What can I get you?
C: The organic one, the Breakfast Blend. Thirty kilo.
SA: Thirty kilo of the Organic Breakfast Blend.
C: Exactly thirty, ja. I read that delivery is free from thirty, right?
SA: That's right.
C: Good. And please make the quote in euros, it's easier for our bookkeeping.
SA: Will do.
C: Danke, bye!
